justification: Didn't need the kettle to boil for this one, hun. Everything else picks itself: Purdy's slinging it to my own McCaffrey and JSN this week so I'm not fading either of them, Cook's still Cook, and Aubrey and the Jacksonville lot do their jobs quietly while I'm looking at the fun stuff.
